number: 第二百四十八条の三の四
heading_en: CVA Risk Equivalent Amount under the Reduced BA-CVA
summary_ja: 限定的なBA―CVAによるCVAリスク相当額は、βを一としたK_{full}に割引係数0.65を乗じた額とする。
summary_en: The reduced BA-CVA amount is K_{full}, calculated with β equal to one, times the discount scalar of 0.65.
paragraphs: The CVA risk equivalent amount under the reduced BA-CVA shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the value of K_{full}, calculated with β set to one in the formula in paragraph (1) of the preceding Article, by the discount scalar of 0.65.
